title: Reference settings dialog
requirements: Build a page with an Open reference dialog button opening a modal named Reference settings with description A public harness fixture for a modal keyboard journey. Include a labelled Display name input initially containing Example, Cancel and Save buttons. Opening focuses the input; Tab and Shift+Tab wrap within its controls. Escape, Cancel and Save close it and restore focus to the trigger. Support repeated open/close cycles. Include a Remove reference fixture button followed by an After fixture button; removing the closed fixture leaves keyboard navigation to the latter available.
